description: This file defines several internal sealed classes related to asynchronous work items in the Orleans runtime scheduler, including classes for handling asynchronous closures with and without return values, and a class for closure work items with state.

classes.name: AsyncClosureWorkItem
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous work item that executes a Task-based closure and signals completion.

classes.name: AsyncClosureWorkItem<T>
classes.description: Generic version of AsyncClosureWorkItem that handles closures returning a result of type T.

classes.name: ClosureWorkItem<TState>
classes.description: Represents a work item that executes a closure with a state parameter, with support for asynchronous completion.

methods.name: GetMethodName
methods.description: Static method to generate a method name string from a delegate.
